title: Short exact sequences of finite locally free modules split locally
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $0\to\mathcal E_1\to\mathcal E_2\to\mathcal E_3\to0$ be a short exact sequence, where each $\mathcal E_i$ is locally free of constant finite rank $r_i$ in the sense of [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. There is an open cover $\{U_a\}$ of $X$ such that, on every $U_a$, the sequence is isomorphic to the split sequence $0\to\mathcal E_1|_{U_a}\to(\mathcal E_1|_{U_a})\oplus(\mathcal E_3|_{U_a})\to\mathcal E_3|_{U_a}\to0$.

source.place: Proof of (*), determinant paragraph: local splitting

proof.text: Use all affine opens U of X as the index type (in the same universe as X). Mathlib iSup_affineOpens_eq_top proves they cover X. Restrict S to U and then along IsAffineOpen.isoSpec.inv to Spec Gamma(X,U). The proved source preservesLimitsOfSize_restrictFunctor and the left adjoint restriction instance preserve finite limits and colimits, so ShortExact.map_of_exact preserves short exactness. Restriction preserves finite locally free rank; the kernel is quasi-coherent because it is locally free.

Apply lem-pc-affine-extension-section-surjectivity to obtain an epimorphism on global sections. The affine finite locally free section criterion gives finitely presented projective quotient sections. Lean uses rankAtStalk_eq_of_isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank (proved from finitePresentation_projective_sections with the canonical ring-isomorphism transport), followed by Module.Flat.projective_of_finitePresentation and ModuleCat.projective_of_categoryTheory_projective. Projective.factorThru lifts the identity of the quotient section module to a map s with s followed by Gamma(q) equal to the identity.

The quotient is quasi-coherent, so its tilde-Gamma counit is invertible. Compose its inverse, tilde(s), and the counit of the middle term. Naturality of fromTildeGammaNatTrans and the identity s;Gamma(q)=id prove that this composite followed by q is the identity of the quotient. No invertibility or quasi-coherence of the middle-term counit is needed. This is the fully proved private helper exists_section_spec, not a new postponed lemma.

Apply Mathlib ShortComplex.Splitting.ofExactOfSection with this section, exactness, and monicity of the injection. Map the splitting back along IsAffineOpen.isoSpec.hom. The natural isomorphism from restrictFunctorComp, restrictFunctorCongr and restrictFunctorId identifies the double restriction with the original sequence on U; Splitting.ofIso transports the splitting. Splitting.isoBinaryBiproduct is the required middle-term isomorphism. Biproduct extensionality, f;r=id, f;q=0, and biprod.lift_snd give exactly f;e.hom=inl and e.hom;snd=q. Empty schemes and zero ranks are included without any additional hypothesis.
